systemVariables.heading: System variables
systemVariables.intro: Provided by the engine and injected at compile time. Read-only: the "_SYS_" prefix is reserved. The "_SYS_TB_…" time bases are square waves, true for the first half of each simulated-time period.

items._SYS_FIRST_SCAN: True during the first scan after the simulation starts, false afterwards.

hardware.heading: Hardware configuration
hardware.intro: Link the project to a real board. Without a board, the project stays fully simulated.
hardware.unknownModel: The board "{modelId}" is unknown to this version of Studomate.
hardware.pinsIntro: A pin is linked to a variable through the variable's address.

arduinoUnoR3.intro: Example: %PD2 for pin D2. Mode and inversion can be set for pins carrying a digital input variable.
arduinoUnoR3.wiringHelp: The mode tells whether the internal pull-up resistor is enabled. Inversion tells at which level the variable is true: when checked, it is true when the pin is at 0 V (usual wiring of a button between the pin and GND, with pull-up); when unchecked, it is true at 5 V (active-high sensor).
arduinoUnoR3.pinInvertedAria: Invert pin {pin} (true when the pin is at 0 V)

hardware.webSerialUnsupported: The direct USB link with the Arduino requires a Chromium-based browser (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge...). You can still design and simulate your project.

scene3d.heading: 3D scene configuration
scene3d.intro: Link the project to a 3D simulation scene: a physical model (conveyor, elevator, crossroads...) receives the program outputs and returns the sensors. Without a scene, the project is simulated by its programs alone.
scene3d.sceneNoneDescription: The project does not use a 3D scene.
scene3d.unknownScene: The scene "{sceneId}" is unknown to this version of Studomate.
scene3d.pointsIntro: Each sensor is an input of the project and each actuator an output. An unbound point stays inert.
